current_model_contract: agentkernel_lite_encdec_v1 remains hashlocked to 1506-token tokenizer for protected target_100m frontier runs
interpretation: The current tokenizer is very compact in vocab but expensive in context: roughly 1.8 bytes/token on sampled maintainer rows.
At 4096 tokens this gives only about 7.4KB effective raw-byte context, so a 4096-vocab diagnostic ablation is technically justified.
Opaque A-Z labels are already single-token, so tokenizer work targets input compression/context, not bounded label decoding.
Semantic labels are multi-token and should remain candidate metadata rather than decoder targets for current bounded-choice lanes.
